description: This file contains utility functions and logic for handling tool results, including sanitization, error extraction, media handling, and messaging tool extraction within a larger software project.

methods.name: truncateToolText
methods.description: Truncates a text string to a maximum length defined by TOOL_RESULT_MAX_CHARS, safely handling UTF-16 characters.

methods.name: normalizeToolErrorText
methods.description: Trims and extracts the first line of an error message, truncating if necessary.

methods.name: isErrorLikeStatus
methods.description: Determines if a status string indicates an error based on common error indicators.

methods.name: readErrorCandidate
methods.description: Extracts an error message from various possible object structures.

methods.name: extractErrorField
methods.description: Attempts to extract an error message from a result object, considering status and message fields.

methods.name: sanitizeToolResult
methods.description: Sanitizes a tool result object, truncating text content and removing image data.

methods.name: extractToolResultText
methods.description: Collects and joins text content blocks from a tool result.

methods.name: readToolResultDetails
methods.description: Extracts the 'details' object from a tool result.

methods.name: readToolResultStatus
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes the status string from a tool result's details.

methods.name: isExternalToolResult
methods.description: Checks if a tool result is from an external source based on 'mcpServer' or 'mcpTool' fields.

methods.name: isToolResultMediaTrusted
methods.description: Determines if a tool's media result is trusted based on the tool name and result source.

methods.name: filterToolResultMediaUrls
methods.description: Filters media URLs based on trust level and URL pattern.

methods.name: readToolResultDetailsMedia
methods.description: Extracts media details from a tool result.

methods.name: collectStructuredMediaUrls
methods.description: Collects media URLs from structured media details.

methods.name: extractToolResultMediaArtifact
methods.description: Extracts media URLs and related info from a tool result, considering structured media, legacy paths, and content.

methods.name: extractToolResultMediaPaths
methods.description: Returns media URLs from a tool result.

methods.name: isToolResultError
methods.description: Checks if a tool result indicates an error or timeout.

methods.name: isToolResultTimedOut
methods.description: Checks if a tool result indicates a timeout.

methods.name: extractToolErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a human-readable error message from a tool result.

methods.name: resolveMessageToolTarget
methods.description: Resolves the target string for messaging tools from arguments.

methods.name: extractMessagingToolSend
methods.description: Constructs a MessagingToolSend object for sending messages via different tools, normalizing provider and target info.
